'''Kual D'Arsan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] on [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]]. Pale skinned, but of indeterminate age, he had access to many secrets and personal information of the elite of [[Maslovar]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
